items.source: Rather than the location to a file, its Base64 encoded content can be provided. If you chose this option, the value of the property should start with base64:.
items.translation: 与其提供文件路径，可以提供其Base64 编码内容。 如果您选择了此选项，该属性的值应以base64:开头。

items.source: If you’re using environment variables to configure the bundle, the name of the bundle is always converted to lowercase.
items.translation: 如果您使用环境变量来配置 bundle，则 bundle 的名称始终转换为小写。

items.source: getManagers() provides access to the KeyManagerFactory and TrustManagerFactory instances as well as the KeyManager and TrustManager arrays that they create.
items.translation: getManagers() 提供对 KeyManagerFactory 和 TrustManagerFactory 实例的访问，以及它们创建的 KeyManager 和 TrustManager 数组。

items.source: An SslBundle can be retrieved from the auto-configured SslBundles bean and used to create objects that are used to configure SSL connectivity in client libraries. The SslBundle provides a layered approach of obtaining these SSL objects:
items.translation: 可以从自动配置的 SslBundles Bean 中检索 SslBundle，并使用其创建用于在客户端库中配置 SSL 连接的对象。 SslBundle 提供了获取这些 SSL 对象的分层方法：

items.source: PEM content can also be used directly for both the certificate and private-key properties. If the property values contain BEGIN and END markers then they will be treated as PEM content rather than a resource location.
items.translation: PEM 内容也可以直接用于 certificate 和 private-key 属性。如果属性值包含 BEGIN 和 END 标记，则它们将被视为 PEM 内容，而不是资源位置。

items.source: The following example shows retrieving an SslBundle and using it to create an SSLContext:
items.translation: 下面的示例展示了获取一个SslBundle并使用它来创建一个SSLContext：

items.source: Once configured using properties, SSL bundles can be referred to by name in configuration properties for various types of connections that are auto-configured by Spring Boot. See the sections on embedded web servers, data technologies, and REST clients for further information.
items.translation: 配置属性后，SSL 捆绑包可以通过名称在 Spring Boot 自动配置的各类连接配置属性中引用。有关更多信息，请参阅嵌入式 Web 服务器、数据技术和REST 客户端部分。

items.source: Spring Boot auto-configures a bean of type SslBundles that provides access to each of the named bundles configured using the spring.ssl.bundle properties.
items.translation: Spring Boot 自动配置了一个类型为SslBundles的 Bean，该 Bean 提供了对使用spring.ssl.bundle属性配置的每个命名 Bundle 的访问。

items.source: getStores() provides access to the key store and trust store KeyStore instances as well as any required key store password.
items.translation: getStores() 提供访问密钥库和信任库 KeyStore 实例以及任何必需的密钥库密码。

items.source: createSslContext() provides a convenient way to obtain a new SSLContext instance.
items.translation: createSslContext() 提供了一种便捷的方式来获取新的 SSLContext 实例。

items.source: Configuration properties with the prefix spring.ssl.bundle.jks can be used to configure bundles of trust material created with the Java keytool utility and stored in Java KeyStore files in the JKS or PKCS12 format. Each bundle has a user-provided name that can be used to reference the bundle.
items.translation: 以 spring.ssl.bundle.jks 为前缀的配置属性可用于配置使用 Java keytool 工具创建的信任材料包，这些材料包存储在 JKS 或 PKCS12 格式的 Java KeyStore 文件中。每个包都有一个用户提供的名称，可用于引用该包。

items.source: See JksSslBundleProperties for the full set of supported properties.
items.translation: 有关支持的完整属性集，请参阅 JksSslBundleProperties。

items.source: See PemSslBundleProperties for the full set of supported properties.
items.translation: 请参阅 PemSslBundleProperties 以获取完整的支持属性集。

items.source: In addition, the SslBundle provides details about the key being used, the protocol to use and any option that should be applied to the SSL engine.
items.translation: 此外，SslBundle 提供了有关所使用的密钥、要使用的协议以及应应用于 SSL 引擎的任何选项的详细信息。

items.source: Spring Boot provides the ability to configure SSL trust material that can be applied to several types of connections in order to support secure communications. Configuration properties with the prefix spring.ssl.bundle can be used to specify named sets of trust material and associated information.
items.translation: Spring Boot 提供了配置 SSL 信任材料的能力，这些材料可应用于多种类型的连接以支持安全通信。可以使用前缀为 spring.ssl.bundle 的配置属性来指定命名的一组信任材料及相关信息。

items.translation: 以 spring.ssl.bundle.pem 为前缀的配置属性可用于配置以 PEM 编码文本形式表示的信任材料包。每个包都有一个用户提供的名称，可用于引用该包。

items.translation: 您可以使用 spring.ssl.bundle.watch.file.quiet-period 属性配置文件观察器的静默期（以确保不再有更多更改）。

A file watcher is then watching the files and if they change, the SSL bundle will be reloaded.
This in turn triggers a reload in the consuming component, e.g. Tomcat rotates the certificates in the SSL enabled connectors.
items.translation: 随后，文件监视器将监控这些文件；如果文件发生变化，SSL 捆绑包将被重新加载。这进而会触发消费组件的重新加载，例如 Tomcat 将在启用了 SSL 的连接中轮换证书。
